info.name: SkillAlign API - Complete Collection
info.description: Comprehensive Postman Collection for SkillAlign Recruitment & ATS Platform Backend APIs (FastAPI).

request.description: Allows public users to register as a Candidate. Privileged roles cannot be created here.
Authenticates credentials and returns a signed JWT access token.
Returns the profile information and role of the currently authenticated user.
Updates the profile information (name, phone, email) of the authenticated user.

item.name: POST - Request OTP for phone login

request.description: Sends a 6-digit OTP to the provided phone number. Valid for 5 minutes.
Verifies the OTP. If the phone is new, creates a Candidate account. Returns a JWT.
Resends OTP to the phone number. Subject to cooldown period.

item.name: POST - Create HR or Recruiter user

request.description: Admin creates a new privileged account (HR or Recruiter). Role must be 2 (HR) or 3 (Recruiter).
Returns all registered users with optional role filtering.
Returns aggregate counts of total users, active users, HRs, recruiters, candidates, and skills.
Update user name or toggle is_active status (activate/deactivate).

item.name: GET - List all skills (All authenticated roles)
GET - Get skill by ID (All authenticated roles)
POST - Create a new job (Recruiter only)

request.description: Recruiter creates a job with title, min experience, description, and required/preferred skills with weights.
List jobs. Recruiters can filter by their own jobs, HR can view active jobs for matching.
Recruiter updates their own job specifications and associated skills.
Recruiter deletes their own job. This will also remove all associated job skills and match results.

item.name: GET - Get candidate's job matches and pipeline statuses

request.description: Returns all job matches, current pipeline stage (Matched -> Screened -> HR Approved -> Interview Scheduled), and interview details for the logged-in candidate.
Secure resume upload outside database. Validates type and size limits.
Add a skill with proficiency (Beginner, Intermediate, Expert) and years of experience.

item.name: PUT - Update skill proficiency or years
GET - View candidate profile by ID (HR & Recruiter)
POST - Upload Candidate Resume (PDF, DOCX, TXT) and Run Extraction & Parsing

request.description:
Uploads candidate resume, stores original in S3, extracts readable text,
stores extracted TXT in S3, parses structured data using deterministic rules,
and auto-synchronizes skills with the master database taxonomy.

item.name: GET - Get Pre-signed S3 URL to View/Download Original Resume

request.description:
Generates a secure, temporary pre-signed URL with ExpiresIn=300 (5 minutes).
Accessible by Candidate (own profile), Recruiter, HR, and Admin.

item.name: DELETE - Delete Candidate Resume & Extracted Documents from Storage

request.description:
Deletes original file and extracted TXT from storage and clears database columns.
Accessible only by the Candidate owner or Admin.

item.name: GET - Get Extracted Plain Text (.txt) of Candidate Resume

request.description:
Returns the clean extracted plain text representation of the resume.
Accessible by Candidate (own profile), Recruiter, HR, and Admin.

item.name: GET - Get Structured Parsed Data (Skills, Experience, Education, Certifications)

request.description:
Returns structured parsed fields extracted deterministically from resume text.
Accessible by Candidate (own profile), Recruiter, HR, and Admin.

item.name: POST - Run matching engine for a job (Recruiter)

request.description: Scores all candidates against job requirements using weighted proficiency matching, saves results to match_results setting recruiter_id, and returns ranked candidates.

item.name: GET - Get match results for a job (HR & Recruiter)
GET - List screened candidates ready for HR approval (HR)

request.description: Returns all candidate matches that have been screened by recruiters and are awaiting HR approval or interview scheduling.

item.name: GET - List active pipeline candidates (Recruiter & HR)

request.description: Returns candidates advancing through the hiring pipeline.

item.name: POST - Add feedback scorecard for a candidate (HR & Recruiter)
GET - Get all scorecards for a match result (HR & Recruiter)
GET - List screened candidates for HR
GET - Get match result by ID

request.description: HR schedules an interview for a candidate, transitions match status to 'interview_scheduled', and dispatches candidate notification via SendGrid and in-app alert.

item.name: PATCH - Update interview status or feedback (HR & Admin)
POST - Create and dispatch notification (HR Only)

request.description: HR dispatches email notifications to candidates regarding interview schedules, status updates, or rejections.

item.name: GET - List all users with pagination, search, and filters (Admin only)

request.description: Returns a paginated list of all users. Supports server-side filtering by role, status (active/deactivated), and search by name or email. Response includes pagination metadata.

item.name: GET - Get extended user detail (Admin only)

request.description: Returns full user profile including candidate resume info, recruiter jobs, skills.

item.name: PATCH - Toggle user active/deactivated status (Admin only)

request.description: Quickly activates or deactivates a user account. Admin accounts cannot be toggled.

item.name: DELETE - Permanently delete a user (Admin only)

request.description: Permanently deletes a user account and cascades all related candidate data, skills, and applications.
Liveness check returning current service health status.
